technical-specificity-faster.title: Technical specificity regarding business inputs and goals predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
technical-specificity-faster.body: Pitches that detail specific business inputs, professional skills, concrete objectives, or economic and environmental rationales accelerate funding regardless of gender.

business-duration-faster.title: Specifying the number of years a business has operated predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
business-duration-faster.body: Pitches that include the specific duration of business operation or professional experience tend to accelerate funding for both men and women.

female-savings-goal-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention the goal of building savings fund faster.
female-savings-goal-faster.body: Pitches from women that explicitly state the intention to build up savings are associated with increased funding speed.

verbosity-slower-general.title: Higher verbosity and excessive personal detail predict slower funding regardless of gender.
verbosity-slower-general.body: Pitches that are significantly longer or contain excessive personal narrative tend to fund more slowly for both men and women.

monthly-income-slower-general.title: Pitches that include specific monthly income figures predict slower funding regardless of gender.
monthly-income-slower-general.body: The inclusion of precise monthly income amounts is associated with slower funding speeds for both male and female borrowers.

female-business-success-faster.title: Female borrowers who emphasize that their business is currently doing well or is being sustained fund faster.
female-business-success-faster.body: Pitches from women that highlight current business success or the ability to sustain operations through previous support accelerate funding.

female-family-future-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention securing the future of their family fund faster.
female-family-future-faster.body: Pitches from women that emphasize the long-term security and future of their family are associated with increased funding speed.

female-nwtf-resurgence-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention sustaining business through past NWTF loans fund faster.
female-nwtf-resurgence-faster.body: Pitches from women that explicitly mention using previous loans from NWTF to sustain their business activities accelerate funding.

female-business-challenge-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention a specific business challenge may fund more slowly.

female-community-impact-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention community-level impact and economic development may fund faster.

female-gratitude-slower.body: Female borrowers who express gratitude to lenders or organizations may fund more slowly.

female-idr-amount-slower.body: Female borrowers who include a specific loan amount in Indonesian rupiahs (IDR) may fund more slowly.

female-widow-status-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention being a widow may fund more slowly.

female-dedicated-farmer-faster.body: Female borrowers who describe themselves as 'dedicated smallholder farmers' may fund faster.

female-geography-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention specific geographic locations like towns or cities may fund more slowly.

female-repayment-history-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention their own previous loan repayment history may fund faster.

female-devoted-mother-slower.title: Female borrowers who describe themselves as a 'devoted mother' may fund more slowly.
female-devoted-mother-slower.retrospective: Retired as stale puzzle to make room for new observations.

female-hardworking-label-slower.title: Female borrowers who describe themselves as a 'hardworking entrepreneur' may fund more slowly.
female-hardworking-label-slower.retrospective: Retired as stale puzzle to make room for female-idr-amount-slower.

female-widow-status-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention being a widow may fund faster.
female-widow-status-faster.retrospective: Retired due to contradictory evidence in batch 1081.

female-senior-age-slower.title: Female borrowers who mention being aged 60 or older may fund more slowly.
female-senior-age-slower.retrospective: Retired as stale puzzle to make room for female-dedicated-farmer-faster.

female-photo-caption-slower.title: Female borrowers who include a caption for the photo may fund more slowly.
female-photo-caption-slower.retrospective: Dropped as stale puzzle to make room for new observations.

female-photo-person-id-faster.title: Female borrowers who explicitly identify a person in their photo may fund faster.
female-photo-person-id-faster.retrospective: Dropped as stale puzzle to make room for new observations.

female-city-center-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention their business is located in the city center may fund faster.
female-city-center-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that geographic locations correlate with slower funding.

female-inventory-detail-slower.title: Female borrowers who provide highly specific inventory weights or regional details may fund more slowly.
female-inventory-detail-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that listing specific inventory items accelerates funding for women.

female-family-loan-history-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention a family member's positive loan repayment history may fund faster.
female-family-loan-history-faster.retrospective: Dropped as stale puzzle to make room for female-nwtf-resurgence-faster.

female-family-details-faster.title: Pitches from women that specify the number of children, their ages, or the professional status of a spouse are associated with increased funding speed.
female-family-details-faster.retrospective: Retired to make room for claims with stronger recent evidence.
